issue.title: Add a --dry-run flag
issue.body:
## Goal

Add a `--dry-run` flag.

- prints the plan
- writes nothing

- [x] parse the flag
- [ ] skip writes

| flag | effect |
|---|---|
| --dry-run | no writes |

```js
run({ dryRun: true });
if (a  <  b) done();
```

Ship it 🎉
